stepTitle: $$\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}|y_i-\hat{y}_i|**{3}$$ is an appropriate loss function that penalizes outliers more harshly than MSE.
stepBody:
Which of the following functions are appropriate loss functions that also penalize outliers more harshly than MSE? Select all that apply.
• $$ rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\hat{y}_i)$$
• $$ rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**{3}$$
• $$ rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}|y_i-\hat{y}_i|**{3}$$
• $$ rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**{4}$$
• $$ rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**{5}$$
• $$ rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}|(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**{5}|$$
